caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical doorway framed by an ornate architectural structure. At the center is a double door with eight rectangular panels, four on each side, colored in muted reddish-brown with green borders and subtle floral star patterns in the middle of each panel. The door is set into a recessed entryway with walls decorated in swirling pastel tones of yellow, green, and pink, and a line of yellow trim about halfway up the wall. On either side of the doorway, two classical columns with vertical grooves and decorated bases and capitals support an entablature. Above the columns is a horizontal band with a marbled pattern in yellow, green, and pink tones matching the wall pattern. On top of this is a triangular pediment-like structure with a circular medallion featuring a stylized flower in blue, gold, and red at the center. The sloping edges of the pediment are adorned with a golden-yellow leaf motif, and the ends are capped with decorative acorn or pineapple-shaped finials colored in blue, gold, and red. The floor is tiled in a reddish-brown color, and the column bases sit on slightly raised, rectangular plinths in a similar hue. There are small, green, wall-mounted fixtures or planters on either side of the door, attached to the marbled section of the walls. The background is plain, and the artist's signature, "EDWARD T. JEWETT," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doorway, Wall Painting and Doors
